desktopEn:
Refine the provided approved direction A into a polished FULL homepage desktop design screenshot, English, one single page (no device chrome, no board labels, no mobile inset). Preserve its warm ivory paper, vermilion accents, elegant editorial serif headlines, ink sans-serif UI, olive secondary chart, thin rules, restrained open layout. Not geeky, no dashboard clutter, no neon, no cards everywhere. Tall portrait image approximately 1440 wide x 2200 high, desktop layout with generous outer margin and refined whitespace. Complete page all five sections, deliberate visual hierarchy.
Header: Ziliang Zhang | Tools Engineering Notes Contact | EN / 中文.
First viewport: narrow left identity column, wider right interactive loan comparison. Small red 01 (not huge), serif headline "Making data explorable and AI useful." Intro "AI applications, data, and backend engineering." Primary red text arrow "Try changing a parameter", secondary "Get in touch". Right title Loan comparison with small Preview badge. Clean large chart Monthly payment vs Years: vermilion horizontal Equal payment line and olive straight declining Equal principal line; direct legend, small "Illustrative". Term slider with minus/plus and "25 years"; collapsed More inputs. Compact table columns First month, Last month, Total interest, two method rows and em dashes for all numeric values. Button Explain the difference; secondary quiet View data. AI explanation initially collapsed.
Below thin rule, 02 TOOLS: three open editorial columns. Loan comparison / Preview / "Explore repayment structures and see how assumptions shape outcomes." / "Try above ↑"; AI stock screener / Planned / "Turn natural language into explicit filters and inspect the results."; Japan tax calculator / Planned / "Explore tax rules through clear inputs and a transparent breakdown." No clickable controls on planned tools.
03 ENGINEERING: left large serif "Behind the interface." Small paragraph "Experience with data platforms for machine learning and configuration-driven engineering." Right restrained two text rows "Data for machine learning" / "Pipelines that support recommendation systems." and "Configuration-driven platforms" / "Turning recurring data workflows into reusable systems." Below full-width quiet strip "How the loan preview will work" and simple text flow "Inputs → Calculation → Chart + table → AI explanation". Small copy "Calculations determine the results. AI explains the same snapshot." This is design of future preview, no claims of existing working backend. Two subtle source links "Goto · Go CLI ↗" and "VuePress · open source ↗". No metrics, employer logos, fabricated testimonials or job timeline.
04 NOTES: elegant compact three numbered editorial link rows with titles "Algorithms", "Web API Design", "Handwritten Digit Recognition", small topic tags and right arrows. No fake dates.
05 CONTACT: generous final serif "Let's build something useful." Visible "lucienzhangzl@gmail.com ↗" as primary contact, GitHub ↗ and LinkedIn ↗ secondary. Tiny footer "Ziliang Zhang" and EN / 中文.
Layout polished full-page website, text legible, not slide deck. Only hero controls use filled red, lower sections mostly typography. Keep sections concise; no dark bottom panel or gradient.
